_readme: Copy this file to seed/content.json and replace it with your real content.
seed/content.json is gitignored on purpose: templates, partners, and names
are your data, never application code (PRD build guardrail 6).
ownerUid is the host UID that owns these documents. It must already be in
hp_config/allowlist or the host app will not show them.
Task offsets are days relative to the event: -35 means 35 days before,
2 means two days after. Run of show offsets are minutes from the start.
ownerSlot is either 'host', 'all', or the exact name of a role slot.
To rename a template or partner that is already in Firestore, add a
"renameFrom" field holding the old name. Without it the rename creates a
second document and the events keep pointing at the old one.

templates.name: Example morning run
templates.description: Replace this with one of your real playbooks.

taskSkeleton.title: Date options out to all parties

orgs.name: Example Partner
orgs.renameFrom: Old name, only while renaming something already in Firestore
orgs.description: One line about what they do.
orgs.notes: Lead times, preferences, anything worth remembering
